acceptanceCriteria: A timed-out MTP run leaves no socket or temp files under the report directory; a test or live witness asserts it.
body: Found by the V1-0593 native runner lane (beamfall/corvint#1001, head 20b4c6e0e, 2026-10-17, macOS 26 arm64). Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/native-2026-10-17/cases/. After a timeout, Microsoft.Testing.Platform runs (NUnit/MSTest/xUnit) leave their IPC socket files under <report dir>/.tmp. Processes are retired, but filesystem residue remains. Expected: timeout cleanup removes the MTP temp/socket files (or the run uses a per-run temp root that is removed), and the cleanup check asserts no residue.

title: MTP profiles leave socket files in the report directory's .tmp after a timeout
